## Work order (draft)

- Title: Component A feed loss / C header pressure loss / Feed composition variation
- Priority: High
- Suspected causes: IDV(6), IDV(7), IDV(8)
- Evidence: XMEAS(1) (down), XMV(3) (up), XMEAS(20) (down), XMEAS(29) (down)
- Requested inspection:
    - For IDV(6): Check the stream 1 supply: upstream isolation valves, header pressure, and supplier status; inspect the stream 1 flow transmitter and the feed valve; verify the stream 1 line for blockage or leakage. (Source: inspection_guide_by_disturbance.md)
    - For IDV(7): Measure the C header pressure at the field gauge; check the supply source and the pressure regulator on the C header; inspect the stream 4 feed valve and the flow transmitter. (Source: inspection_guide_by_disturbance.md)
    - For IDV(8): Sample the stream 4 feed over time and verify the composition variability; check the feed analyzer and the upstream mixing or blending point; verify the stream 4 flow transmitter for noise. (Source: inspection_guide_by_disturbance.md)

## Shift handover

The alarm started at sample index 173. The approved diagnosis indicates a potential component A feed loss (IDV(6)), C header pressure loss (IDV(7)), or feed composition variation (IDV(8)). Confidence is very high with an agreement between samples of 1.00. No evidence was rejected by the gate. Maintenance inspection of streams 1 and 4 is pending.

- Priority: Medium

- Evidence: XMEAS(23) (down), XMEAS(25) (up), XMEAS(29) (down), XMEAS(31) (up)
- Requested inspection: 
    - For IDV(7): Measure the C header pressure at the field gauge; check the supply source and the pressure regulator on the C header; inspect the stream 4 feed valve and the flow transmitter. (Source: inspection_guide_by_disturbance.md)

    - For IDV(1): Check the stream 4 flow measurement and its transmitter calibration; sample the stream 4 feed and verify the A/C ratio against the analyzer reading; inspect the stream 4 feed control valve and the upstream supply of A and C. (Source: inspection_guide_by_disturbance.md)

## Shift handover

The alarm started at sample index 173. The approved diagnosis suggests a C header pressure loss (IDV(7)), feed composition variation (IDV(8)), or an A/C feed ratio change (IDV(1)). Confidence is high with an agreement of 1.00 between samples, although the gate status is only partial. The evidence from XMEAS(1) was rejected by the gate. Maintenance inspections for the three suspected causes are pending.
